title: Brief-change diff: --baseline classifies every cell fixed, regressed or noise
deviations_from_card: Case 7 (resume) lives in a NEW colocated app/_lib/interview-sim/runner.test.ts instead of engine.test.ts, which slot A owns this wave; it uses a hand-built SimInstrument over TEST_AGENDA, so no DB write. Two classes beyond the card's four + not_comparable: 'unchanged' (same rate both sides) and 'targeted_regression' (the change made its own target worse) - both also blocking on reliability, a deliberate reading of the technique's 'block on any reliability regression'. Noise is made precise: baseline cell flipped across >=2 of its own samples AND one-sided binomial tail at the baseline rate >= 0.05 (NOISE_ALPHA); a baseline that never flipped has no spread, so every flip is real. Small additions inside the write set: instrumentConflicts also refuses two different situationSha of one situation when merging samples (old dumps without it are not a conflict); verdictRuns warns when a dump's situationSha differs from the current bank entry (the verdict-run.ts:439 premise); CLI validates --targets ids against SIM_INVARIANTS + the bank and refuses --targets without --baseline; loadBaseline accepts the verdict dir, the run dir holding verdict/, or the verdicts.json file.
notes: Keyless: baseline-diff.ts reads two verdicts.json files and never calls a model. Full npm run test:unit: 9867/9868 - the one failure is app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts ('child must have forked its grandchildren'), a spawn-timing test under 6-builder load; it passes 3/3 alone and touches nothing of mine. tsc: zero errors in my paths; whole-tree tsc was red only on sibling in-flight files (app/features/tools/analyze/*, app/features/tools/profile/*, app/_lib/voice/director-exchange.test.ts es2018 regex flag - slot A) and on the untracked kpi-sim/ copy. test:perf red on three lines: job-ingest.ts 402/400 (known), plus app/page.tsx 8678/8664 KB and app/api/jds/generate/route.ts 3024/3023 KB - neither can reach app/_lib/interview-sim (no app route/page imports it; only scripts and slot A's call-observations.ts/director-exchange.ts reference interview-sim), so those are sibling growth. Integration note: slot A landed c7d497f59 (director kernel) before my commits; my engine.ts change is one line (situationSha on the dump) and did not conflict. Old dumps and old verdicts.json have no situationSha: the first resume after this lands re-runs every situation once, and a diff against a pre-change baseline reports every cell 'cast unknown' - re-verdict the baseline dumps after a fresh run to compare.
